proposed.text: Within what timeframe must the Board submit LEA ratings to the Commission after the examination, unless extended for just cause?

options.text: Within thirty calendar days after the examination.
Within five working days after the examination.
Within one year after the examination.
Only when the IAPOA requests the ratings.

rationale.correct: Section 16 requires the Board to submit ratings to the Commission within thirty calendar days after the examination, unless extended for just cause. The source says submit ratings, not announce results.
